thread:
marie: Thinking about DP ops: propose daily 15m async "standup" thread per partner (one message from partner + one from us) to keep momentum without heavy meetings. Thoughts?

ed: Love the async idea. Also add a short 'priority queue' field where partners can pin 1-2 critical prompts/issues that we commit to investigate within 48h.

tyler: To make it low-friction, we should provide a template message partners can paste:

`Partner: Quick update - baseline p99 X ms, synthetic run Y mins, top concern: prompt #12 latency spike. Requested action: KV prefill / investigate batch sizing.`

sophia: Agree. We should pair that with weekly 30m syncs only if the async queue has >3 open action items. Otherwise keep it async to respect partner time.

marie: Incentives brainstorm: small platform credits ($1k) + co-marketing blurb for completed pilots. Also offer a technical office hours slot mid-pilot. Helps participation.

recruiter-lee: I'll include the async standup expectation in the outreach/one-pager. Short line: "Daily single-line update in thread + weekly structured feedback form (3 required checkpoints)."

ops-bot: capacity-note: rapid triage queue needs on-call window: 9am-5pm PST weekdays. Reserve 1 dev-hour/day for pilot triage. Run `/reserve hours=5 tag=dp-triage` to lock.

marie: SLAs: Critical issue ack within 4 hours, investigation update within 24h, remediation plan within 72h. Non-critical ack 24h, fix in 7 days. Keep these in DP addendum.

legal-bot: DP addendum flags: include explicit consent for single-line telemetry in thread, clarify retention (30d), opt-out for specific fields, and partner right to pause tests. I'll draft a paragraph.

ed: For feedback capture, two channels: (1) the daily single-line thread, (2) a mandatory mid-pilot form with structured prompt-level judgments (rating + short note). That form feeds the eval job.

tyler: UX ask: add a tiny UI widget in the partner dashboard called "Pin for investigation" that posts directly into our triage queue. One-click action.

sophia: Success definition: at least one actionable mitigation validated (e.g., KV prefill reduces p99 by >=15% on target prompt) AND partner reports they'd keep feature routed to prod for 4+ weeks OR give a positive ROI signal.

marie: Recruitment filter tweak: prefer partners with an engineer who can commit 20-60 minutes/day for the first 2 weeks and who can run a synthetic scenario on request. Keeps experiment velocity high.

recruiter-lee: I'll update the invite script: short DM, include the daily-async expectation, credit incentive, and a one-line ask for their avg rps + willing time window.

ed: Next steps: Lee sends outreach list by Thu, Ops reserves triage hours by Fri, Tyler prototypes the dashboard pin by next Tue. Any objections?

marie: No objections. :rocket:
